sourceDiscrepancies: Armorer: the core sourcebook includes Tinkerer–Falling Avalanche and Imbue Item–Reinforce Item; the compilation omits them. Both saved connections remain.
Headbutt and Unstoppable: unranked in the sourcebook glossary despite compilation rank markers.
Hard Headed: glossary starts at Daunting and reduces difficulty only per additional rank; Improved Hard Headed starts at Formidable and likewise excludes the first rank.
Acklay’s Scything Strike: the compilation says Attack; the original source name and IDs remain.
Embrace Your Hate: ordinary active, ranked; both saved Force labels are removed.
mechanicsFixes: Inner Peace cancellation, zero and whole-point input.
Indomitable Will commitment validation before maneuver spending, plus activation-strain reservation and refund.
Far Strike action spending on failed range extension or declined Force costs, Short-range use with committed dice and zero-Force guard.
Hard Headed one-action limit, staggered exception, disabled spent button and save/resume of the exception.
limits: Physical iPhone Safari and installed-PWA offline behavior were not tested.
Gearhead attachment-cost reduction, Reinforce Item, Tinkerer item selection, Sapith Sundering, Improved Dodge movement, difficult terrain and Improved Hard Headed recovery remain manual.
Headbutt non-vehicle/silhouette eligibility and exact next-round expiry require manual checking.
Indomitable Will reduces ordinary enemy-weapon damage automatically; other damage sources require manual handling.
Additional hits can repeat Embrace Your Hate and Falling Avalanche bonuses; subtract repeated damage manually.
Automatic dark-talent Conflict is added at Morality resolution rather than displayed at session start; avoid entering it twice.
Acklay Pierce and Martial Grace automatic support covers unarmed/Far Strike profiles; other Brawl weapons require manual resolution.
Force-use eligibility, multiple lightsaber-form selection and the official defense cap are not uniformly enforced by older handlers.
Older action-used turns without the new staggered marker are treated as already spent.
Existing saved purchases, ratings and characteristics are not retrospectively recalculated.

changes.before: Removes Mechanics setbacks and reduces attachment-modification costs automatically.
changes.after: Removes Mechanics setbacks automatically. Halve attachment-modification credit costs manually.

changes.before: Adds defense for qualifying armor. Apply the official maximum defense of 4 manually where older handlers exceed it.
changes.after: Adds defense for qualifying armor. If your displayed total exceeds 4, apply the maximum defense of 4 manually.

changes.before: The combat control commits dice, reserves activation strain, tracks its use and charges continuing strain. Weapon attacks reduce damage automatically; resolve other damage sources manually.
changes.after: Commits chosen dice, pays activation and maneuver costs, tracks its encounter use and charges continuing strain. Weapon attacks reduce damage automatically; resolve other damage sources manually.

changes.before: Successful close-combat attacks offer its Destiny cost, one-hit damage and use limit. Morality resolution adds the automatic +1 Conflict at session end; treat it as pending from session start and avoid entering it twice.
changes.after: Successful close-combat attacks offer its Destiny cost, damage and encounter-use limit. If additional hits repeat this bonus, subtract it from those hits manually. Morality resolution adds the automatic +1 Conflict at session end; treat it as pending from session start and avoid entering it twice.

changes.before: Successful Lightsaber attacks offer strain-for-Brawn damage on one hit. Enforce its once-per-round limit manually.
changes.after: Successful Lightsaber attacks offer strain-for-Brawn damage. Track once-per-round use manually and subtract any repeated bonus from additional hits.
